name: coldshift-dash-convoy
description: The Convoy relay on Cloudflare Workers: cars driving together see each other on the map and send each other messages

START_KEY.description: Required: a secret only you and the apps you approve know. Starting a convoy needs it (none set: no convoy can be started); joining one needs only its link and password. Use a long random one, e.g. from `openssl rand -base64 24`.

PUBLIC_URL.description: Leave empty: links and QR codes use the address your copy is reached at.

STARTS_PER_HOUR.description: How many convoys one address may start in an hour.

IDLE_HOURS.description: A convoy with nobody in it ends after this many hours, its messages and voice notes with it.

ADMIN_KEY.description: Optional, and yours alone (never give it to the apps): it lets you list the convoys on your relay and end one, with tools/convoys.py. None set: nobody can.
